rule: adopt a candidate only if its validation IoU beats the current model by >= 0.005; test and Bolivia are reported once, never used to choose

experiments.label: current model (base 16, 30 epochs)
experiments.summary: Improvement attempts, decided in advance by validation IoU only (adopt if at least 0.005 better; test and Bolivia never used to choose): 4x larger (base 32, 50 epochs): validation 0.6285, Bolivia 0.536; weight averaging (EMA 0.995 with warm-up): validation 0.6247, Bolivia 0.585; weight averaging + brightness augmentation (+-1.5 dB): validation 0.6242, Bolivia 0.590.; an ensemble averaging three of them (no training): validation 0.6281, Bolivia 0.607. None beat the current model (validation 0.6293), so it was kept. Across the four variants the unseen-event (Bolivia, 15 chips) IoU ranges 0.536-0.648: that estimate varies a lot between trainings, so our 0.648 is likely at the favourable end. The limit is the training data, not the model size or training procedure.

experiments.label: ensemble: average of current, V1 and V2 (no training)
